FTLRecomp for Windows 10/11
===========================

FTL: Faster Than Light, rebuilt natively, with the same fixes and controls as
the Switch version (FTLRecomp-NX).

You need your own copy of FTL (Steam, GOG or Humble). This download does not
include the game data.

Setup
-----
1. Unzip this folder somewhere you can write to, such as your Desktop or
   Documents. Not "Program Files": the game saves next to FTLRecomp.exe.
2. Copy ftl.dat from your FTL install into this folder, beside FTLRecomp.exe.
   Steam:  C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\FTL Faster Than Light\ftl.dat
   (Steam library > right-click FTL > Manage > Browse local files.)
3. Double-click FTLRecomp.exe. Windows SmartScreen may warn about an
   unrecognised app because the file is not signed: click "More info", then
   "Run anyway" (French: "Informations complementaires" > "Executer quand meme").

Controls
--------
Mouse and keyboard work as in the original game. An Xbox or other game
controller works with the Switch controls (see the project README).

PC keys:
  F11  frame-time / FPS overlay
  F8   reset the window size
  Fullscreen: in-game Options menu

Files beside FTLRecomp.exe
--------------------------
  ftl.dat                 your game data (required)
  recomp-*.json           settings, profile and saved run
  FTLRecomp.log           log, useful for bug reports
  FTLRecomp-logging.ini   set console = true to see the log live

Project: https://github.com/axewoo/FTLRecomp-NX
